name: Orbs Overlay
description: A draggable Discord-window overlay for locally customizing the displayed Orbs number and appearance. Does not change real account balance.
features: Snap to left or right edge
Remember bubble position in plugin settings
install: Copy src/plugins/orbsOverlay into the Endcord source tree under src/plugins/, then build and inject Endcord. This JSON is repository metadata, not a one-click Endcord installer.
